contextDisplayDesc.zh: 输入区的上下文占用怎么画：饼图、圆环配绿到红，或圆环配蓝、黄、红三色。
contextDisplayDesc.en: How the composer draws the context share: the pie, dsh's ring on the green-to-red band, or the measured ring on three bands.

contextNumbersDesc.zh: 关闭后上下文环、饼图旁不再显示百分比，只留下图形。
contextNumbersDesc.en: Hides the percentage beside the ring or pie, leaving the shape alone.

statsFooterAlignRequired.zh: 只在选择「紧凑底栏」时生效。
statsFooterAlignRequired.en: Applies only to the Compact footer position.

billingCurrencyDesc.zh: 会话费用按哪一种官方价表计算；关闭则不显示费用。
billingCurrencyDesc.en: Which official price table the session's cost follows; off hides the cost.
